create_exl2_weight: create an Exl2Weight dataclass instance with q_weight, q_scale, q_invperm, q_scale_max, and q_groups tensors
get_exl2_linear_layer: call get_linear on an Exl2Weight instance with a bias tensor to return an ExllamaQuantLinear layer
load_exl2_weights: use Exl2WeightsLoader get_weights to load exl2-quantized weight tensors from a Weights object by prefix
get_exl2_column_weights: call get_weights_col on Exl2WeightsLoader to retrieve column weights for a given prefix
get_exl2_row_weights: call get_weights_row on Exl2WeightsLoader to retrieve row weights for a given prefix
